Blues Fan of the Week

By Mike Rider | November 15, 2026

Mary Gaddis Kennett, MO

Share:

Mary Gaddis of Kennett, MO, is the 101 ESPN Blues Fan Of The Week presented by CARSTAR!

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:31
Instaread

As our Blues Fan Of The Week, Mary scores a pair of tickets to a Blues Home Game later this season … Congrats, Mary!

Our Blues Fan of the Week is presented by CARSTAR.(opens in new tab) Don’t sit on the sidelines. Call your local CARSTAR today or visit carstar.com(opens in new tab) and get back in the game.

Blues fans! Send us a pic of you repping your Blues gear, and you could be chosen as our Blues Fan Of The Week!

If chosen, you’ll win a pair of tickets to a Blues Home Game later this season.

No purchase necessary. Must be a resident of Missouri or Illinois.

  • Max. file size: 50 MB.
  • If you're chosen for Blues Fan of the Week, you'll get two tickets to an upcoming game! Let us know your top 3 preferences here.
